title: Standalone registered launcher cannot take a clone-local user temp without inherited environment
outcome: A runner can keep the documented standalone committed-input launcher form while using a validated, separate clone-local user temp for the launcher, Rust wrapper and non-Cargo stages, without user or global configuration changes.
acceptance: A supported clone-local setting lets a bare registered full or focused launcher invocation select a separate repository-local user temp without an inline environment assignment, a shell wrapper, or a global configuration edit.

The launcher and its relevant preflights and stages honor the selected temp root, preserve existing temp-containment checks, and retain configured behavior for callers that use the environment variable.
Behavior tests cover the supported standalone invocation and show the selected directory is used without altering committed source identity.
